title: Users can evade paying fees
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `TokenFactory` charges fees for both buying and selling tokens.  ```solidity         // initialize fees         protocolFeeBips = 150;         creatorFeeBips = 250;          protocolFeeWithReferralBips = 100;         creatorFeeWithReferralBips = 250;         referralFeeBips = 50; ```  The issue here is that users can evade paying both fees by simply trading their tokens in the open market (e.g. Dex, Uniswap pairs, etc...)  ## Recommendations  Consider pausing all transfers when `curve.isPaused` is `false`.
